entries.back_en: "Pardon me. [says] that we wish to cross to the other bank. How can [it/you] get there, please?"
entries.note: 'the other bank' shortened to 'la' (there), but meaning preserved; acceptable.

entries.back_en: "We must assume that the workers also escaped. How disappointing..."
entries.note: 'were able to escape' rendered as 'escaped' and 'then' dropped; meaning intact.
